name: Grow the FedRAMP Marketplace
text: Continue to partner with government and industry to promote the adoption of secure cloud services across the federal government

name: Transform Processes
text: Incorporate automation and process improvements to improve the efficiency and stakeholder experience of the end-to-end FedRAMP process with the ability to accommodate future growth

name: Promote Knowledge Sharing
text: Provide more opportunities for dialogue and feedback by hosting additional events for collaboration, feedback, training and exchange of ideas and practices
